name: NinetyLens: Football AI
subtitle: Smart Match Stats & Previews
promotional_text: Pick any game, spend a credit and get AI-powered probabilities with clear context. No subscription: buy credits only when you need them, mate.
description:
Watch every game through a clearer, data-informed lens. NinetyLens turns football (soccer) fixtures and team context into AI-powered probabilities you can actually read.

WHY NINETYLENS
• Match probabilities for the result, goals and likely scorelines, with the data behind them
• Analyses written for you: language, depth and focus follow your own profile
• Favourites and history that stay with you
• No subscription: one-off credit packs, with the cost shown before you spend

HOW IT WORKS
1. Browse the day's fixtures in a quick daily calendar.
2. Open a match and unlock the analysis with credits. The cost is always shown first.
3. Read the probabilities, confidence, available data and clear limitations. Come back to it any time from Analyses.

FIND MATCHES BY DATE
Move through the calendar, see kickoff times and competitions together, and filter down to your favourite teams.

SAVE YOUR FAVOURITES
Mark the matches you care about and find them again after closing the app.

TRANSPARENT AI ANALYSIS
Every analysis shows probabilities for the match result, goals and likely scorelines, how confident the model is and which data was available. If an analysis already exists for the same match and data, it is reused rather than charging you twice.

ANALYSIS HISTORY
Reopen earlier analyses from the Analyses tab and see at a glance whether they are still current.

CREDITS WITHOUT A SUBSCRIPTION
Buy a one-off pack of 5 or 10 credits whenever you want more analyses. Purchased credits do not expire.

PRIVACY FIRST
NinetyLens uses an anonymous account. You can sign out or permanently delete your account and linked data inside the app. The Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are always available in the app.

SUPPORTED LANGUAGES
English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Español, Français.

IMPORTANT
AI-powered analyses are for information only. They express probabilities, not certain outcomes, and are not betting advice. Match data may be delayed, incomplete or unavailable. NinetyLens is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any club, league, federation or data provider.

Download NinetyLens and see the next game differently.
